newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission postpones deadline for additives.
newsitem.headline: Commission postpones deadline for additives.

text.p: The European Commission is asking for a one-year extension to the deadline for authorising the marketing and use of enzymes and micro-organisms in animal feed, a document released on Thursday states.
The Commission was given until January 1 to finalise the authorisation of national lists and to apply common rules on the use and labelling of products by the Council of Ministers in December 1993.
But, the document states, only half the submitted files have been initially examined.
"It should be pointed out that neither the Member States nor the Commission expected to receive such a large number of authorisation applications...", the document says.
Because of the possible economic consequences for companies that rejection would entail, the Commission is proposing to postpone the deadline date for one year to January 1998, it adds.
